note: Part 1 of the protocol in docs/next-measurement.md: readiness-probe-failure, three attempts. ALL THREE were refused at the FIRST node — Assemble — with "no such scenario: undefined", so no model was asked and nothing was spent on tokens. The runner posted alert.json alone, and the chain reads body.scenario, a field no alert file carries. Nothing had ever posted this body: the run harness builds its own item and the generate tests read the workflow as text, so the one field a real call must carry was the one field nothing checked. The answers are beside, in docs/answers/, because they are not a cost record. Issued by scripts/run-scenarios.mjs against the deployed workflow's webhook. The reply carries the chain's report; it does not carry the model's token usage, because the Collect nodes keep only the reply. Token counts and cost are therefore UNESTABLISHED on this path, not zero — read them from the n8n execution and add them with a second edit if they are wanted, and say that they were added by hand.
recorded: at the moment the answers arrived, by the script that issued them

totals.why: the webhook reply carries no usage; nothing here could read it
